new: Login page now captures and stores a local display name so you only type it once per browser.
One-tap leader signup added to session cards using the saved display name.
Sessions now store attendance in explicit leader arrays instead of CSV-style text, keeping manual edits compatible.
Declined leader list added so sessions can track who can and cannot make it separately.
changed: Header now shows a compact 'Signed in as ...' label beside the Water Rats title on desktop.
Leader signup and edit modals now manage attending and declined names as lists instead of comma-separated text.
Session spreadsheet and dashboard views now reflect attending and declined counts.
Firestore session writes now validate array-based leader lists.
fixed: Manual leader editing remains available through the existing edit flow while supporting one-tap signup.
Current signed-in name now pre-fills response actions and no longer needs repeated re-entry.

new: Updated Readme with new screenshots, descriptions and information architecture diagram to reflect recent UI and feature changes.
changed: Sanitised uploadedData.ts by removing sensitive data and personal information.
Moved Firebase configuration keys to .env file to enhance security and prevent exposure of credentials.
fixed: Fixed title of Leader Signup modal to correctly display 'Sign Up as Leader' instead of 'Edit Session'.

new: Minimum number of leaders field added to sessions — set a required minimum (1+) or no minimum (0).
Add Session and Edit Session modals now include a Min. Leaders Required input with a 'No minimum' toggle button.
Leader needed indicators now dynamically reflect each session's configured minimum across cards, spreadsheet, calendar, and dashboard.
Migration utility added to backfill existing sessions with minNumberOfLeaders = 3.
Custom discard changes confirmation modal replaces browser confirm dialog.
changed: Session type updated: minNumberOfLeaders is now a required number (0 = no minimum).
'Need Leaders' dashboard stat now uses per-session minimum instead of a hardcoded threshold.
Leader count badges on session cards now display current/minimum ratio.
Add Session and Edit Session modals now prompt with a styled modal before discarding unsaved changes.
Min. Leaders input styling improved - blue 'No minimum' button when active, grayed out input when no minimum is set.

new: Mobile bottom navigation bar added for improved mobile UX.
Click-to-expand notes functionality in session spreadsheet - entire row is now clickable.
Inline editing for session fields (Activity, Group, Location, Leader in Charge, Expected Attendees) without needing edit button.
changed: Complete responsive design overhaul - all pages optimised for mobile and large screens.
Dashboard layout now displays 4 stat cards in a row on desktop, with This Week and Upcoming Sessions side-by-side.
Session calendar now scrolls horizontally on mobile with abbreviated day headers (M/T/W).
Session spreadsheet now has proper horizontal scrolling on smaller screens.
Leader page optimised for mobile with smaller avatars and truncated email handling.
Changelog page now uses responsive padding instead of fixed percentages.
Header reduced in height on mobile to save screen space.
Main footer now responsive with smaller text and proper mobile spacing.
fixed: Modal overlay gap at top of screen resolved by moving modals outside space-y container.
Modal backdrop now properly closes modals when clicked.
Session spreadsheet column widths optimised - wider columns for longer content (Date, Activity, Location).
Dashboard week view now wraps session details properly on mobile.
Unused variable warnings cleaned up across components.

new: Copy session functionality added to session cards.
Visual feedback implemented for successful session copy actions.
Leader signup functionality added to sessions.
Improved session action controls in the session spreadsheet.
UUIDs introduced for more reliable session identification.
changed: Session filtering logic refined for better accuracy and performance.
SessionCalendar and SessionSpreadsheet components updated to reflect new session model.
Minor UI adjustments across session-related components.
fixed: Footer positioning and opacity adjusted for improved visibility.
Resolved edge cases when filtering sessions with incomplete date information.

new: Complete overhaul of session date and time handling.
Sessions now support explicit start times or "Time TBD" states.
Firebase session data model updated to support flexible date/time storage.
New session calendar and spreadsheet views introduced.
changed: Session dates and times are now stored using Firebase Timestamps instead of inferred values.
Filtering logic rewritten to operate on structured date/time fields.
Session-related queries updated to reflect the new data model.
Session management UI restructured to support the new workflow.
fixed: Inconsistent session ordering caused by mixed date formats.
Incorrect filtering when sessions had missing or placeholder times.
Edge cases where sessions failed to render due to invalid date values.
breaking: Session date/time fields in Firebase were restructured.
Legacy session records require migration to the new format.

new: Loading states added when fetching sessions.
Additional session metadata displayed in cards and forms.
changed: Layout component renamed to Header for clarity.
DynamicForm and SessionCard components enhanced for flexibility.
General codebase refactoring for readability and maintainability.
fixed: Default values in session add/edit modals now initialise correctly.
Session time input now uses a dedicated time field instead of free text.

new: Public-facing sessions page introduced.
New session management modals added.
Firebase authentication utilities integrated.
changed: Calendar view replaced with dedicated SessionCalendar component.
Session management UI split into calendar and spreadsheet views.
Logout styling updated for improved visibility.
fixed: Session view toggle now correctly resets filters.

new: Initial session management system introduced.
Calendar-based session view added.
Leader assignment and session status tracking implemented.
changed: Session data structures standardised.
Destination field renamed to location across the application.
fixed: Dashboard and session rendering errors on mobile devices.

new: Initial project setup.
Basic authentication and dashboard scaffolding.
Early session and leader management features.
